entities.title: Players and waves
entities.summary: Games hold the right ships in the right places, and waves come as the rules say.
criteria: A game holds 1 to 9 players; attract mode holds none
Every player starts apart from the others, on the field

More players and later waves bring more rocks, up to the cap

entities.title: Losing ships, and the two modes
entities.summary: Ships are lost and come back as the rules say, co-op and versus treat shots differently, and the game ends only when everyone is out.
criteria: Touching a rock costs a ship, and the ship comes back guarded
A shield takes one hit
Two ships that touch are both lost, in co-op and in versus
A ship still guarded after appearing doesn't collide with another
Co-op shots pass through other ships; versus shots take them down for points
A ship's own shots never hit it
An extra ship every 10,000 points
The game ends only when every player is out of ships

The attract backdrop runs for minutes without ships
A simple bot clears waves and scores
Nine bots in co-op play a full game and it ends

entities.title: Determinism and replays
entities.summary: The same seed and controls give the same game, and a recording replays to exactly the same scores.
criteria: The generator is deterministic and uniform enough
The deterministic sin, cos and atan2 agree with Math to 1e-12 over many turns
The same seed and inputs replay the same game
Controls round-trip through their bits
A recorded game replays to exactly the same scores, for 1 to 9 players in both modes
A replay rejects recordings that don't play exactly one whole game
A recording made with another seed doesn't replay as this one
Replaying a long game takes under 200 ms per minute of play
